irs.publisher: Internal Revenue Service, Statistics of Income
irs.title: Individual Income Tax Statistics, ZIP Code Data

zcta.title: 2020 ZIP Code Tabulation Areas, ACS 2022 boundary service

relationships.title: 2020 ZCTA to County and County Subdivision Relationships

fields.label: Share of NJ investment income
fields.note: Share of inflation-adjusted annual investment income in all mapped areas with published IRS figures. Same 2018–2022 years and 2022 dollars as the panel.

fields.label: Tax records: annual income per household
fields.note: Annual average AGI, adjusted year by year to 2022 dollars using BLS CPI-U, divided by ACS households in the same mapped area. Combined-source estimate; returns are not linked to households.

fields.label: Annual average AGI, 2022 dollars
fields.note: Sum of each year's AGI multiplied by CPI-U 2022 / CPI-U year, divided by five years.

fields.label: Annual average investment income, 2022 dollars
fields.note: Taxable interest, ordinary dividends and net capital gains; each year adjusted using CPI-U, then averaged.

fields.label: Investment share of reported income
fields.note: Inflation-adjusted investment income divided by inflation-adjusted AGI across 2018–2022.

fields.label: Annual average tax returns
fields.note: Sum of returns for 2018–2022 divided by five. Not unique filers.

fields.label: Tax returns
fields.note: Returns filed for the latest tax year. Rounded to 10 by the IRS.

fields.label: Adjusted gross income per return
fields.note: Five tax years pooled. Legacy research field in nominal dollars; not the household-normalized map measure.

fields.label: Wages per return
fields.note: Five tax years pooled.

fields.label: Investment income per tax return
fields.note: Taxable interest, ordinary dividends and net capital gains. Five tax years pooled.

fields.label: Investment income, annual average total
fields.note: Sum of taxable interest, ordinary dividends and net capital gains across all mapped returns, divided by the number of tax years.

fields.label: Net capital gains per return
fields.note: Five tax years pooled.

fields.label: Partnership and S-corp income per return
fields.note: Five tax years pooled.

fields.label: Investment income share of AGI
fields.note: Five tax years pooled.

fields.label: Returns with AGI of $200,000 or more
fields.note: Five tax years pooled.

fields.label: Average AGI of returns at $200,000 or more
fields.note: Five tax years pooled. Blank where the IRS suppressed the class.

fields.label: Share of AGI on returns at $200,000 or more
fields.note: Five tax years pooled.

fields.label: Share of mapped investment income
fields.note: Five tax years pooled.

fields.label: Share of mapped tax returns
fields.note: Five tax years pooled.

fields.label: Median household income
fields.note: Mapped ZCTA median. In 2022 dollars. The Census reports 250,001 for any median above $250,000.

fields.label: Household income margin of error
fields.note: 90% confidence margin for the median, from the mapped ZCTA. In 2022 dollars. Blank when unavailable or top-coded.

fields.label: Census: average household income
fields.note: ACS B19025 aggregate household income divided by B19001 households, summed over the assigned ZCTAs. Published in 2022 dollars; not adjusted again. Excludes capital gains.

fields.label: Households with income of $200,000 or more
fields.note: Highest category in ACS table B19001. It has no upper edge.

fields.label: Median gross rent
fields.note: Monthly rent plus utilities. The Census reports 3,501 for any median above $3,500.

fields.label: K-12 students in private school
fields.note: Private includes religious schools. Charter schools count as public.

fields.label: Homes held for occasional use
fields.note: Vacant units for seasonal, recreational or occasional use.

fields.label: Share of homes held for occasional use
Tax years available
fields.note: Number of tax years matched. IRS measures require all five years and at least 1,000 latest-year returns.

fields.label: Households margin of error
fields.note: 90% confidence margin. Combined-area margins use the square root of summed squared ZCTA margins; this approximation ignores covariance.

fields.label: Aggregate household income margin of error
fields.note: 90% confidence margin in 2022 dollars. Combined-area approximation ignores covariance. The map mean has uncertainty in both its numerator and denominator.

fields.label: ZIP area
fields.note: 2020 Census ZCTA code; matched to the same five-digit IRS postal ZIP in New Jersey.

fields.label: Principal municipality
fields.note: NJ municipality with the largest land overlap. It is a label, not a municipal income estimate.

fields.label: Principal county
fields.note: NJ county with the largest land overlap.

fields.label: Matched postal ZIP
fields.note: Same-code match only. PO-box and unique ZIPs without a ZCTA are excluded; no redistribution.

fields.label: Intersecting NJ counties
fields.note: NJ counties with positive land overlap.

fields.label: Intersecting NJ municipalities
fields.note: NJ municipalities with positive land overlap; useful for search.

fields.label: Share of ZCTA land in NJ
fields.note: Included when at least half the ZCTA land is in NJ. ACS covers the whole ZCTA; IRS covers NJ-filed returns. Border areas may differ.

inflation.name: CPI-U, U.S. city average, all items, annual averages

comparison.note: Both map layers use ACS household counts and 2022 dollars. IRS is a combined-source estimate, not linked household returns. Definitions and coverage differ; their difference is not a measure of missing income or wealth.
comparison.legacy_fields: Other IRS dollar fields and original concentration shares remain nominal unless their names end in _2022.

pull_date_note: Source-level dates show the most recent successful file download; source_files records individual file dates. Original cache dates are inherited from its source-family record.

coverage.note: Regional shares refer to mapped areas with published figures, not all residents or returns. Same-code postal ZIP/ZCTA match. Census covers whole ZCTAs, IRS only NJ returns. PO-box/unique ZIPs without polygons are not redistributed.

latest_irs.note: Coverage of published mapped ZIPs against the official NJ state-total row (00000). A single tax year in nominal dollars, distinct from the five-year map and concentration chart.
